Title: fix(cypher): procedure YIELD variables are in scope for subqueries in its WHERE
Reason: Procedure YIELD bindings are rejected inside subqueries in the YIELD WHERE; grouped identity bindings also lose scope.

Title: perf(cypher): scoped CALL DISTINCT keys hold only projected values; shared value-equivalence index
Reason: Scoped CALL DISTINCT keys include hidden imports; unify value equivalence and retain imports for ordering.

Title: fix(cypher): DISTINCT treats map-wrapped and native paths as the same value
Reason: The value-equivalence index must hash native paths and genuine map-wrapped paths identically.

Title: fix(cypher): CALL (*) is one scope clause for static checks and runtime; rebound imports keep their types
Reason: CALL (*) static/runtime import readers disagree and rebound/empty-aggregate imports lose type facts.

Title: fix(cypher): an aggregate CALL import keeps its integer exclusion, so an invalid list index is rejected statically
Reason: A global aggregate CALL import loses agreed nonInteger/predicateDeferred facts and accepts statically invalid list indexes.

Title: fix(cypher): read dotted words, spaced qualified names and comments with the shared lexical readers
Reason: Spaced qualified calls, dotted keyword properties and comment contents bypass shared lexical readers.

Title: fix(cypher): CASE result-type unions reject function arguments only when no branch fits
Reason: CASE result types need unions; function signatures may reject only when every alternative is incompatible.

Title: fix(cypher): restore the agreed integer exclusion when joining aggregate import alternatives
Reason: Restores #1345 facts lost by #1351; port the final joined-operand result once rather than replaying the temporary regression.

Title: fix(cypher): keep inner aggregates inside commented COUNT/EXISTS/COLLECT subqueries on develop
Reason: Comment/form-feed boundaries let inner scalar-subquery aggregates escape and misclassify COUNT as a map projection.

Title: fix(cypher): per-row evaluation order, subquery scopes and operation owners on develop (#1214)
Reason: Unreached operands can raise errors; subquery evaluation order, null slices, operand error policy and versioned logical folds diverge from Neo4j.

Title: perf(cypher): plan correlated CALL subqueries once per statement
Reason: Correlated CALL/subquery expressions repeatedly plan clause text for each row; cache a statement-local clause plan.

Title: perf(cypher): finish moving clause-text scanning onto the statement's parse-once plan
Reason: Remaining correlated-clause/logical/index-seek/result-modifier scans repeat per row; use the statement-local plan consistently.

Title: perf(cypher): compile map literals in aggregate arguments; at most one row copy per evaluation
Reason: Generic map-literal aggregate arguments are reparsed and rows recopied; compile maps and preserve the prepared scope map even without added bindings.

Title: perf(cypher): cheaper correlated EXISTS reads and zero-hop quantified paths
Reason: Existing correlated EXISTS/COUNT and single-hop predicates repeatedly load/evaluate full candidates; semi-joins and shared endpoint/equality reads bound that work.
